blocks.2: Birkeli has strung the wires and now we have got the light,
blocks.4: it shines so nicely now from the farmhouse and the cowshed,
blocks.6: In the cowshed the cow stands gazing her fill at the light,
blocks.8: she eats little hay and gives such a lot of milk
blocks.10: The rake runs on electricity and starts mucking out at once.....
blocks.11: and the cowpats fly like big black crows........
blocks.12: Straight across the floor and out through the hatch......
blocks.13: they fly so fast that you only see their shadow.......
blocks.14: The washcloth flies up and quickly wipes the udders......
blocks.15: and the milk spurts into the pails so it roars......
blocks.16: Then we turn the switch once more with our hand.......
blocks.17: and off home trundle all the milk pails.......
blocks.18: But before we leave the cowshed we do something funny.......
blocks.19: and we have found out that it saves so much hay......
blocks.20: We fasten a wire to the cow's rear end........
blocks.21: and charge the cow up so she just stands there farting.......
blocks.22: Now we would like to bring those in charge........
blocks.23: thanks from ourselves and greetings from the animals.......
blocks.24: Over in America, we know, there is said to be.....
blocks.25: an electric chair that is said to be so grand......
blocks.26: We'll buy one like that even if it's expensive
blocks.28: and give it as a gift to those in charge
